name: brd_blk_alloc_disk
bug: On the blk_alloc_disk()/add_disk() failure path of brd_alloc() the brd_device obtained from brd_find_or_alloc_device() is released by brd_free_device(brd). Removing that call leaks the brd_device (and its xarray) when disk allocation fails during module initialisation.
reachable: brd_init() calls brd_alloc() in a loop at module load, so failing blk_alloc_disk()/add_disk() with fail-nth reproduces the leak.
reference: Models the class of early-exit leaks MLEE targets: a resource acquired by a helper and released on one error branch that a code change omits.
